title: Branch and merge on a model railway
label: Model railway: main line with commit stations, a feature line that peels off on an S-curve and rejoins main by a short crossover beside a two-stud merge station, and an ink-outlined cart labelled main. Move across the board to step commits.
caption: Move across the board to commit; the far right merges. Each commit is a station with one stud per parent and committing lays track: while main stands still its cart just fast-forwards along feature's line, and once main has moved, a merge station with two studs joins the lines.
